affliction.description: Scarlet leprosy is widely feared for its devastating effects, crushing bones and organs while making recovery nearly impossible. Damage taken from scarlet leprosy can’t be healed until the disease is cured.
affliction.name: Scarlet Leprosy

stages.effect: 2d6 bludgeoning damage, and whenever you gain the wounded condition, increase the condition value by 1
stages.name: Stage 2

stages.effect: 4d6 bludgeoning damage and can’t heal any Hit Point damage
stages.name: Stage 3

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: An effect with this trait applies one or more diseases. A disease is typically an affliction.

traits.name: Virulent
traits.text: Afflictions with the virulent trait are harder to remove. You must succeed at two consecutive saves to reduce a virulent affliction’s stage by 1. A critical success reduces a virulent affliction’s stage by only 1 instead of by 2.
